verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers monday.com's AI-agent/MCP integration, event-webhook subscriptions (create_item, change_column_value), and agent-building features, but contains no mention of a scheduling engine, recurring triggers, cron-like automation, or 'run on schedule' capability for workflows. Community evidence is unrelated to this axis (general product complaints). Without any documented schedule/recurring-trigger mechanism, this applicable automation-workflow capability is unevidenced.
